name: telegram
description: Telegram MCP server for Claude Code and AI agents. 74 tools for chats, history, search, sending, media, contacts, groups, admin, topics, reactions, polls and folders, on your real account.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your own Telegram account over MTProto.

Most Telegram integrations are bots, and a bot only sees messages sent to that bot. This signs in as you, so it can read the group you were actually talking in and answer in it.

Setup needs an api_id and api_hash from my.telegram.org, then a one-time phone login that produces a session string. That string is full access to the account and does not expire, so it is stored as a sensitive value and can be revoked from Telegram under Settings, Devices.

Sending posts as you and deleting with revoke removes messages for everyone, so delete refuses to run without an explicit confirmation and is disabled entirely unless you turn it on.

api_id.title: API ID
api_id.description: From my.telegram.org, under API development tools.

api_hash.title: API hash
api_hash.description: Issued with the API ID, on the same page.

session.title: Session string
session.description: From `telegram-mcp login`. This is full access to your account and does not expire. Revoke it under Settings, Devices in Telegram.

tools.title: Tool profile
tools.description: core is 13 tools and about 2,500 tokens every turn. read is 7 reading tools only. full exposes everything.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can send, edit, forward or delete.
